# Nexy

> A Python framework for fullstack web applications: FastAPI and Starlette on the server, Vite on
> the client, and one origin for both. A route is a file under `src/routes/`.

Nexy is meant to be read without a browser and without a build step. Start with the documentation
index, follow the page for the task, and trust the source when the two disagree.

## Documentation

- [Index](docs/README.md): every page in the documentation

### Getting started

- [Installation](docs/getting-started/installation.md): Install uv and the Nexy CLI, then create your first project
- [Quick start](docs/getting-started/quick-start.md): Create a project, run it with live reload, and build it for production
- [Tutorial](docs/getting-started/tutorial.md): Build a notes page with an endpoint, shared data and a production build
- [Core concepts](docs/getting-started/core-concepts.md): Get the mental model: route, page, view, component, handler, endpoint
- [How Nexy works](docs/getting-started/how-nexy-works.md): Follow one request from the URL to the file that answers it
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): Know which layer does what, and what Nexy leaves to your application
- [Project structure](docs/getting-started/project-structure.md): Know what every folder and file in a project is for
- [Choose a router](docs/routing/README.md): Pick the file-based, modular or custom router
- [Choose a view format](docs/views/README.md): Pick `.nexy`, Markdown or a client framework for a page
- [Coming from another framework](docs/getting-started/coming-from-other-frameworks.md): Translate FastAPI, Next.js and Express habits into Nexy

### Routing

- [File-based routing](docs/routing/fbr/README.md): Turn a file path into a URL
- [Pages](docs/routing/fbr/pages/README.md): Write a page
- [Dynamic routes](docs/routing/fbr/pages/dynamic-routes.md): Use `[slug]`, `[...path]` and route groups
- [Page metadata](docs/routing/fbr/pages/metadata.md): Set the title, description and share image of a page
- [Layouts](docs/routing/fbr/layouts/README.md): Share a frame between pages
- [Inheritance](docs/routing/fbr/inheritance.md): Read the resolution order of layouts, dependencies and error pages
- [Server mode and client mode](docs/routing/fbr/modes.md): `useCSR`, and what each mode allows
- [Linking and navigating](docs/routing/fbr/navigation/linking-and-navigating.md): Link pages, navigate on the client, prefetch
- [Hooks](docs/routing/fbr/navigation/hooks.md): Read the path, query, cookies and session
- [Route handlers](docs/routing/fbr/handlers/README.md): Add a Python endpoint
- [Validation and errors](docs/routing/fbr/handlers/validation-and-errors.md): Answer `422` and `404`, and raise an `HTTPException`
- [WebSocket handlers](docs/routing/fbr/realtime/websocket.md): Handle a `SOCKET` connection
- [Dependencies and guards](docs/routing/fbr/dependencies/README.md): Run `dependencies.py` before a handler, and inherit it
- [Middleware files](docs/routing/fbr/middleware/README.md): Wrap requests with `middleware.py`, inherited by directory
- [Error pages](docs/routing/fbr/errors/README.md): Answer with `notfound.nexy`, `errors.nexy` and JSON errors
- [Modular routing](docs/routing/modular/README.md): Mount controllers and modules
- [Dependency injection](docs/routing/modular/dependency-injection.md): Define services, their scopes and the container
- [Guards and metadata](docs/routing/modular/guards-and-metadata.md): Protect and document routes
- [Custom routing](docs/routing/custom/README.md): Include an existing FastAPI app

### Frontend views

- [Frontend pages](docs/views/frontend/pages.md): One file, one route: props, rendering, metadata
- [Frontend layouts](docs/views/frontend/layouts.md): The document shell, nesting, and what a layout cannot do
- [Frontend actions and navigation](docs/views/frontend/actions-and-navigation.md): Call a typed Action, link pages, read the URL
- [React differences](docs/views/react/differences.md): Setup, pages, layouts, islands, actions
- [Vue differences](docs/views/vue/differences.md): Setup, pages, layouts, islands, actions
- [Svelte differences](docs/views/svelte/differences.md): Setup, pages, layouts, islands, actions
- [Solid differences](docs/views/solid/differences.md): Setup, pages, layouts, islands, actions
- [Preact differences](docs/views/preact/differences.md): Setup, pages, layouts, islands, actions
- [.nexy files](docs/views/nexy/README.md): Write a page with Python, Jinja2 and props
- [Components](docs/views/nexy/components.md): Use `Image`, `Link`, `Audio`, `Video` and `Import`
- [layout.nexy](docs/views/nexy/layouts.md): Write the server-mode layout
- [Markdown and MDX](docs/views/nexy/markdown.md): Write content pages

### Rendering

- [Rendering](docs/rendering/README.md): Which rendering mode fits a page
- [SSR](docs/rendering/ssr.md): Server rendering, the default
- [ISR](docs/rendering/isr.md): Cache pages with stale-while-revalidate
- [CSR](docs/rendering/csr.md): Client-side routing
- [Islands](docs/rendering/islands.md): Hydrate on idle, visible or media query

- [Troubleshooting](docs/guides/troubleshooting.md): Fix the first problems people hit

## Source

- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md): the packages of Nexy and their mechanisms, for contributors
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): development workflow and quality gates
- `nexy/core/config.py`: option defaults
- `nexy/modules/routers/fbrouter/`: routing implementation
- `nexy/modules/compiler/`: `.nexy` and Markdown compilation
